I was physically unable to switch out propane tanks on my other one! With this one I can -- as long as the tank isn't completely full. Manufacturers of propane grills need to be cognizant of the fact that there are indeed women of a "certain age" who grill and who do not have a strong person around to swap the tanks out.

Photos.Caption: You can see the dent where the shelf meets the body. There's also a dent just to the right of the round plastic iGrill cover

Results.ReviewText: I've been very happy with the grill, but of course it's only been two months, and time will tell. The one thing I'm very unhappy with has to do with the Home Depot person who sold it to me. She told me that I needed to move the grill by pushing down on the permanent shelf that's on the same side as the wheels. This gets the side without wheels to lift off the ground. It's awkward, but it works. But after her using this method to get the grill to my car, and me using it to get my grill from my driveway to my house and on my deck, I noticed that the permanent shelf was now bent down noticeably.  I looked in the instruction book and sure enough, it says to move the grill by holding onto the body of the grill on the opposite side as the wheels and lifting it. So, thanks to bad instructions from Home Depot, my poor Weber grill has started off its life with a bent shelf. I've managed to unbend the shelf somewhat, but it's still a bummer. The Home Depot I bought it at is an hour away and it would be a hassle to bring it back, so I'm living with it.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought a Spirit grill about 7 years ago, and the back of the fire box blew out shortly after purchase.  I contacted Weber who sent a new fire box, however, I simply covered the softball sized hole with heavy foil and continued using the grill until 2019, when it finally gave out...Back to the replacement firebox that Weber sent 7 years ago...I attempted to replace the box with the new one they sent, and they sent the wrong box, way to big. They sent a 3 burner box and I had a 2 burner box...so, after keeping the replacement box Weber was kind enough to send for 7 years, it didnt fit. Which led me to buy another Weber Spirit. Both are amazing grills. Easy assembly, cook very well, and, like other reviews of this grill, the warming rack does not even come close to fitting.  The dimensions are off by at least a 1/4 to 1/2 inch from fitting into the provided slots, also, even if it was installed, it blocks almost 1/3 of your cooking space.  But, all that being said, Im very happy with both Weber Spirit grills.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
We ordered our Spirit II E-210 after doing a lot of review reading and research.  This grill and the bigger 310 version seem to have some of the best reviews out there.  We decided that the E-210 would suit our needs, and it has.  The size is perfect for the two of us, and I’m sure for a couple of guests we might have over.  
	The grill arrived less than a week after ordering, and we unpacked and laid all the pieces out on our living room floor.  The assemble instructions were pretty easy to follow, and we just took our time and had it put together in about 2 ½ hours.  We didn’t notice until we had it fully assembled that the lid had a small crack in the back.  We called Weber customer service, and sent a photo of the crack to the service representative.  He apologized and overnighted us a replacement lid. We were using our grill the very next day.  I’m very pleased with how this company treated us.  
	We have had the grill for several weeks now, and loving it.  I’ve never been much of a griller, Just the occasional hamburgers, or hotdogs, but decided to try some steaks.  Weber has many recipes on their website, and I’ve just followed the one for steaks.  They were fantastic!  We’ve grilled chicken a few times too and are very pleased with the flavor the grill gives them.  Overall, we are glad we made this purchase from Weber.  So refreshing to find a company that takes pride in what the do,  and treats their customers good.
Results.Title: Best Steaks I've ever grilled

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
